notes: S3-FIX1 (decision 2026-11-17 #5): a valid zip container also holds the zero-data directory entry a/../../x/. A directory entry is ignored for the layout but not for path safety: its path, the name without the final '/', has a '..' segment or is absolute, so the zip is E_CONTAINER_ENTRY at entry enumeration (§11.9). The Rust verifier accepted this zip before the fix.
